To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) we propose an approach to integrate pre-layout wire length prediction techniques into logic synthesis, targeting wire congestion, and (ii) we demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on ISCAS'85 benchmarks.
we propose a method to apply wire-length prediction during logic synthesis, targeting interconnect effects.
we propose wire-length-predicton-based technology mapping and wire-length-prediciton-based fanout optimization to improve the congestion of a design.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: How can we apply wire length prediction to improve logic synthesis results in terms of congestion and timing performance? How can we improve the wire length prediction accuracy to better reflect the final layout?
applying pre-layout wirelength prediction to improve the quality of logic synthesis.
applying wire length prediction in technology mapping and fan-out optimization to improve the quality of the resulting design.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed method for applying pre- layout wire-length prediction techniques to technology mapping and fan-out optimization is an effective method to improve the overall performance of the design.
our approach can be used as an effective method for improving the quality of the final design.

our wire-length prediction based technology mapping and fan-out optimization techniques result in a significant reduction of wire length and congestion, and improvement in timing performance, compared to the traditional technology mapping and fan-in optimization methods.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed method is able to reduce the total wirelength by 7.8% and the average wirelength by 8.3% compared to a conventional technology mapper.
our wire-length prediction-based logic synthesis flow can be applied in a standard logic synthesis flow and it can be easily integrated into a commercial synthesis tool.
we have shown that the use of pre-layout wire-length estimation techniques during logic synthesis can improve the final design.
The main takeaway from our work is that
early wire-length-predication-based optimization is an important step to achieve better designs.
early wire length prediction can be used as an effective tool for early interconnect optimization.
wire-length prediction techniques can be applied during logic synthesis to improve the quality of the resulting design.
